first.rationale: Current onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, and two durable records indicate that reducing onboarding friction improved completion, time-to-value, early adoption, and SMB activation. This is the clearest direct response to an observed deterioration with a durable path to qualified long-term revenue. I will verify the prior onboarding result and the pricing result before committing, because promotional pricing may be needed for competitive SMB pressure but its cited evidence has a cohort-pooling caveat.
